name: Guided Availability Inquiry
summary: Adds a privacy-safe guided availability inquiry that turns dates, guest count and stay context into a ready-to-send email without introducing booking or payment complexity.
changes: Adds a guided availability inquiry opened from the conversion rail and contact section
Builds a ready-to-send email from dates, guest count, name and stay context
Validates that departure follows arrival before handoff
Offers clipboard copy as a channel fallback
Keeps all inquiry data client-side and does not persist personal information
Adds permanent regression coverage for the complete inquiry flow
manual_review: Open the inquiry from desktop and Android conversion rails
Confirm invalid date order is blocked with a clear message
Confirm Open mail creates a correctly prefilled email
Confirm Copy text copies the full inquiry
Close using the cross, Escape key and dialog backdrop
title: Guided Availability Inquiry
highlights: Adds a desktop availability contact rail while preserving the successful Android mobile pattern
Uses one responsive component across mobile and desktop
Allows desktop visitors to dismiss the rail for the current session
Keeps the AI launcher clear of the conversion rail at all supported breakpoints
Adds regression coverage for markup, behaviour, accessibility and responsive layout
test_focus: Open inquiry from desktop and mobile conversion rail
Validate departure date must follow arrival date
Close dialog with Escape and backdrop
